definitions.explanation: A person who translates written text from one language to another. Distinguished from an interpreter, who works with spoken language.

examples.japanese: {翻訳者|ほんやくしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}している→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm aiming to become a translator.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{翻訳者|ほんやくしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Who is the translator of this novel?

examples.japanese: ⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧な{翻訳者|ほんやくしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{原文|げんぶん}→原文：20563_genbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ニュアンス→ニュアンス：11138_nyuansu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A skilled translator can accurately convey the nuances of the original text.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{翻訳|ほんやく}→翻訳：01725_honyaku⟧ (translation) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Refers specifically to a person who translates written text. In publishing, the translator's name typically appears on the cover alongside the author's.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {翻訳者|ほんやくしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as translator
- {翻訳者|ほんやくしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧: to aim to become a translator
- ⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{翻訳者|ほんやくしゃ}: professional translator
- ⟦{文芸|ぶんげい}→文芸：12990_bungei⟧{翻訳者|ほんやくしゃ}: literary translator

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {翻訳家|ほんやくか}: translator — emphasizes translation as a profession or calling; {翻訳者|ほんやくしゃ} is more neutral
- {通訳者|つうやくしゃ}: interpreter — works with spoken language, not written
- {訳者|やくしゃ}: translator — a shorter form commonly seen in book credits
